name: something-comforting
title: Something Comforting
summary: Example patch: plays a melody on the speaker.
description: Select Settings > Something Comforting to play approximately 13 seconds of "Something Comforting" by Porter Robinson.
details: The melody plays on the internal speaker, not in the headphones.
The iPod does not react to the buttons while the melody plays.
The Clicker setting does not stop the melody.

steps: Flash a firmware with this patch.
Listen to the internal speaker. The melody plays for approximately 13 seconds.
